t: 洛地王朝的最后一位统治者易卜拉欣·洛地被巴布尔在第一次帕尼帕特战役中击败并杀死.
te: The last ruler of the Lodi dynasty, Ibrahim Lodi, is defeated and killed by Babur in the First Battle of Panipat.
dz: 洛地王朝的最后一位统治者易卜拉欣·洛地被巴布尔在第一次帕尼帕特战役中击败并杀死.
de: The last ruler of the Lodi dynasty, Ibrahim Lodi, is defeated and killed by Babur in the First Battle of Panipat.

t: 由苏莱曼所率领的奥斯曼土耳其人被壮族击败并杀死了匈牙利和波希米亚的最后一位贾吉伦国王.
te: The Ottoman Turks led by Suleiman the Magnificent defeat and kill the last Jagiellonian king of Hungary and Bohemia.
dz: 摩哈克之战:由苏莱曼所率领的奥斯曼土耳其人被壮族击败并杀死了匈牙利和波希米亚的最后一位贾吉伦国王.
de: Battle of Mohács: The Ottoman Turks led by Suleiman the Magnificent defeat and kill the last Jagiellonian king of Hungary and Bohemia.
